evals.prompt: Valent kan ikke finde min telefon selvom vi er på samme netværk, og telefonen kan heller ikke se pc'en. kan du fikse det?
evals.expected_output: Finds that firewalld's public zone doesn't allow the kdeconnect service (1714-1764 tcp/udp); proposes adding it (ideally LAN-only rich rule like the ssh one) with --permanent + --reload; since running as enzord without sudo, gives the exact sudo commands for the user; doesn't touch the ssh rule; waits for OK; says how to verify.
assertions: Identifies the closed firewalld kdeconnect service/ports (1714-1764) as the cause
Uses firewalld (firewall-cmd) with --permanent plus --reload (or equivalent persistent change)
Restricts the opening to the LAN (rich rule / source 192.168.1.0/24) or explicitly explains why not
Does not remove or alter the existing ssh rich rule
Privileged commands are exact commands for whoever runs them (sudo block if non-root; apply-after-OK if root) — not vague prose
Asks for the user's OK / waits before applying
Gives a way to verify (firewall-cmd --list-all, ss/port check, or retry pairing)
For every proposed change, explains in plain language what the setting/command does, what the user will notice, and how to undo it

evals.prompt: jeg har ikke opdateret i et par dage. vil gerne have systemet opdateret, ryddet op i pakke-cachen og fjernet pakker jeg ikke bruger mere. og så synes jeg downloads fra mirrors er ret langsomme
evals.expected_output: Uses full -Syu (or yay -Syu) not -Sy; mentions checking Arch/CachyOS news and that kernel/nvidia update means reboot; cache cleanup via paccache -rk2 (not -Scc), optionally enabling paccache.timer; lists orphans for review instead of blind removal; mirror speed via reflector.conf (country + sort rate) for Arch and notes CachyOS mirrorlists are separate; gives sudo commands to user since not root; waits for OK.
assertions: Upgrade uses full -Syu (pacman or yay), never -Sy <pkg> or bare -Sy
Mentions reboot after the pending kernel/nvidia update (linux-cachyos 7.2.8-2)
Cache cleanup uses paccache (keeping >=1-2 versions), not pacman -Scc
Orphans are listed for review instead of blindly piped into pacman -Rns
Mirror fix targets reflector config (country filter and/or --sort rate) for the Arch mirrorlist
Notes CachyOS repos use separate mirrorlists not managed by reflector
Privileged commands are exact commands (sudo block if non-root; proposed for apply-after-OK if root)
Waits for the user's OK before anything state-changing
Does not claim snap-pac takes a post-snapshot (post hook is masked) — only a pre-snapshot
Finds the leftover download-* dirs in /var/cache/pacman/pkg
Reviews explicitly installed / AUR packages for unused candidates (not just pacman -Qdt orphans)
For every proposed change, explains in plain language what the setting/command does, what the user will notice, and how to undo it

evals.prompt: jeg vil gerne sætte vm.swappiness til 10 og give nvidia_drm fbdev=1. hvordan gør jeg det så det holder efter genstart?
evals.expected_output: Puts swappiness in a new /etc/sysctl.d file, applied with sysctl --system and verified; checks /sys/module/nvidia_drm/parameters/fbdev, finds it already Y (default since driver 570) and says no change is needed; if it does propose a modprobe change, the initramfs rebuild goes through limine-update; sudo commands for user; waits for OK.
assertions: Puts vm.swappiness=10 in a new /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf file (not /usr/lib, not /etc/sysctl.conf, not mixed into the hardening file)
Applies sysctl with sysctl --system (or -p <file>) and verifies with sysctl vm.swappiness
Checks the live fbdev value (/sys/module/nvidia_drm/parameters/fbdev or similar) and discovers it is already Y
Tells the user fbdev needs no change (already enabled by default) — or, if it still proposes making it explicit, says it's redundant
Any initramfs rebuild proposed goes through limine-update (not bare mkinitcpio -P, not editing limine.conf); N/A-pass if none proposed
Privileged commands are exact commands for whoever runs them
Waits for the user's OK before applying
Explains what vm.swappiness controls and the practical trade-off of 10 vs 100 on this machine
Explains what nvidia_drm fbdev does (framebuffer console / TTY) in plain language
Says how to undo each change

evals.prompt: tilføj mig til docker-gruppen, og så vil jeg gerne kunne køre 'systemctl restart coolercontrold' uden at skulle skrive password hver gang
evals.expected_output: Notices docker isn't installed (no docker group) and says so instead of creating the group blindly; if adding a group, uses usermod -aG (with -a) and explains re-login; sudoers drop-in in /etc/sudoers.d/ (no dot in name), NOPASSWD limited to the exact command with full path, validated with visudo -cf before install, mode 0440; explains the lock-out risk and undo; waits for OK.
assertions: Checks and reports that docker is not installed / the docker group doesn't exist
Any group addition uses usermod -aG (append), never -G alone
Mentions that group membership takes effect after re-login
sudoers rule is a drop-in under /etc/sudoers.d/ with a name without '.' or '~'
NOPASSWD is limited to the specific command with full path (/usr/bin/systemctl restart coolercontrold), not ALL
Validates with visudo -cf before installing, and sets mode 0440
Explains what the sudoers rule allows and the risk/how to undo it
Waits for the user's OK before applying
Leads with the solution to the underlying goal; docker gets one factual sentence plus one short question whether to install it — no install pitch, options or warnings
Offers a polkit rule (plain systemctl restart, no sudo) or explains why sudoers is chosen instead

evals.prompt: der er en masse lydudgange fra mine skærme (HDMI/DisplayPort fra grafikkortet) i lydmenuen som jeg aldrig bruger. kan du skjule dem så jeg kun ser dem jeg faktisk bruger?
evals.expected_output: Inspects wpctl status / pw-cli to find the NVIDIA HDMI audio device/node names; writes a WirePlumber 0.5 SPA-JSON .conf in ~/.config/wireplumber/wireplumber.conf.d/ with monitor.alsa.rules disabling the matching device/nodes (not 0.4 Lua); restart user services (as root via -M enzord@ or user does it); explains what it does and how to undo; waits for OK.
assertions: Inspects the live audio devices (wpctl status / wpctl inspect / pw-cli / pactl) to get the actual names
Uses WirePlumber 0.5 SPA-JSON .conf in ~/.config/wireplumber/wireplumber.conf.d/ — not 0.4 Lua (main.lua.d / alsa_monitor.rules)
Match rule targets the NVIDIA HDMI/DP device or nodes specifically, not all outputs
Restart of the user services is targeted at enzord's user manager (systemctl --user -M enzord@ as root, or the user runs systemctl --user)
Any file created under /home/enzord is owned by enzord (runuser or chown), if root
Explains what the rule does and how to undo it
Waits for the user's OK before applying

evals.prompt: installer cronie for mig, jeg har et backup-script i ~/scripts/backup.sh som skal køre hver nat kl 3
evals.expected_output: Notices cronie isn't needed: systemd timers already exist; proposes a user (or system) .service + .timer with OnCalendar=*-*-* 03:00 and Persistent=true; explains what each does, verify with systemctl list-timers, undo; mentions cronie only briefly; hands off to systemd skill if needed; waits for OK.
assertions: Doesn't install anything new: proposes a systemd timer, or notices cronie is already installed (just disabled) and weighs that — no blind 'pacman -S cronie'
Does not propose, offer or suggest installing/enabling extra software (e.g. no 'sig til hvis du vil have cronie') — cron is mentioned at most as a brief fact
Timer uses OnCalendar for 03:00 daily and Persistent=true (so a missed run happens after boot)
Notices ~/scripts/backup.sh doesn't exist and asks/flags it instead of scheduling a missing file silently
Runs as enzord (user timer or User=enzord), not as root unnecessarily
Explains what each unit does and how to undo/disable it
Waits for the user's OK before applying
